observations.statement: POST /checkout fails with a TypeError reading percentOff of undefined in discountV2 in checkout.ts
Errors began two minutes after deploy v1.1.0

hypotheses.summary: discountV2 in checkout.ts reads percentOff from an undefined coupon, most likely a promotion lookup that returns nothing when no coupon code is sent.
hypotheses.confidence_rationale: The stack trace names the function and property but the code was not available to confirm the lookup.

data_gaps: Code evidence is unavailable because the repository is not connected, so the exact cause in discountV2 is not confirmed.
